entries.title: Skitterling Chamber
entries.prompt: Edit this existing Drain Damage title concept with a precise anatomical correction ONLY. Tony is the dark-haired man in the navy shirt holding the teal pipe wrench. His UPPER gripping hand near his right shoulder currently floats without a connected wrist or forearm. Repaint that arm so the upper gripping hand visibly connects through a natural wrist and forearm to an elbow and rolled navy sleeve attached to Tony's shoulder. Arrange the bent arm in front of his navy torso, with enough visible skin between wrist and sleeve to make the connection unmistakable. Keep exactly two arms and two hands on Tony, both naturally gripping the same wrench. Preserve his existing lower gripping arm. Keep Sean, all faces, costumes, wrench, monsters, cockroach rat/alligator, logo lettering, environment, lighting, colors, widescreen framing and dark menu space unchanged. Match the original painted comic art; no new elements.
